question: Why does the isolated #337 reproduction pass on current code RISK_REJECT 14/33 canonical MES strat_122 rows (all from 2026-03-13) with max_drawdown, when PR #373 reproduced 33/33?

gate_facts.risk_engine._check_max_drawdown: byte-identical to PR #373 head d06d885b (git diff shows no drawdown/peak/balance lines changed)
gate_facts.peak_reference: daily_state.account_peak_balance is never set on the replay path (only webhook/runner.py and context/wide_stop_ledger_runtime.py set it), so peak = max(balance, position_sizing.starting_balance=1500). In replay the rule is an absolute floor: balance < $1,200 blocks every entry, and because blocked entries cannot change the balance the state is absorbing.
gate_facts.balance_carry: ReplayEngine._rolling_balance carries the PaperBroker balance across day files; introduced 2026-05-31 (2261c9d), present at #373 and used identically by #373's strat_122_executable_parity_audit.py (one engine, engine.run per day).

B_position_sizing_disabled.note: NOT a clean lever: sizing falls back to 6 contracts, gate fires from 2025-08-04; discard

C_starting_balance_5000.note: NOT a clean lever: balance-keyed ladder sizes 3 contracts; 33/33 rows found but 0/33 pnl match; gate first fires 2026-07-05

equity_path_decomposition_vs_canonical_3.conclusion: The 39 extra trades (36 strat_212, 3 strat_122; net -$606.25) are the sole sufficient cause. Remove them and the balance never reaches the $1,200 floor. The 8 changed fills and the six 2-contract fills only move the crossing date.

bisect_of_the_extra_trades.first_bad: 73bffb1  2026-09-05  Stop orb_breakout firing on a stale or already-broken ORB (#464)
bisect_of_the_extra_trades.hunk_isolation: 73bffb1 with ONLY the six-line replay block (elif candle.session != new_york: orb_high/low = candle.high/low; orb_status = undefined) removed reproduces the pre-#464 population exactly (270 trades, 12 extras, 258/258 identical). The previous_bar_high/low additions are not consumed by strategy/strat_212_122.py and play no role.
bisect_of_the_extra_trades.pre_464_residual_extras: 12 extra trades (1 strat_122, net -$193.75) exist before #464 relative to the #337 rows; they do not reach the floor before 2026-07-07 and are not root-caused here.

mechanism.code: strategy/signal_engine.py: after any TRADE, if state.orb.status is above/below the engine sets daily_state.orb_break_long/short_played (~793-796); on later bars with the same status every strategy not in _ORB_CONTINUATION_EXEMPT is skipped (~1681-1711), including strat_212 and strat_122.
mechanism.before_464: Replay built MarketState for Asian-session bars from the PERSISTED prior-day New York ORB, so orb.status was a stale above/below for hours. The first trade of the day (Asian/London) set the played flag against that stale range, and every later 2-1-2/1-2-2 candidate that day, in London AND New York, was silently skipped.
mechanism.after_464: Outside New York the replay ORB is undefined (mirroring webhook/state_builder.py, which #464 changed the same way for live). The flag is no longer set by stale ranges, so those candidates fire.
mechanism.evidence: 27 bars are TRADE in 73bffb1 and NO_TRADE (No qualifying setup found; candidate_audit empty) in 9201b36. 25/27 had an earlier same-UTC-day TRADE in the good run (asian 7, london 12, new_york 6). 2/27 had none and are left unexplained.

2025-09-17T10:30:00+00:00.good_reason: No qualifying setup found in current market structure.

2026-06-29T08:00:00+00:00.good_reason: No qualifying setup found in current market structure.

implication: The #337 canonical population (258 MES trades incl. the 33 strat_122 rows) and everything derived from it, including #373's 16-trade/+$120 control and #514's +$522.50 counterfactual, were generated while a stale prior-day ORB range was suppressing 2-1-2/1-2-2 candidates after the first trade of the day. Current code (post-#464, live and replay in parity) does not suppress them; the extra 36 strat_212 trades lose $606.25, the carried balance crosses the $1,200 absolute floor on 2026-03-09, and the absorbing max_drawdown gate then blocks every later strat_122 row. The harness fails closed as designed. EXPECTED_CONTROL/EXPECTED_TREATMENT cannot be reproduced on current code without disabling the gate (A) or restoring the pre-#464 suppression, and neither is a legitimate control.
not_changed: No runtime, config, risk, strategy, or replay code was modified. All experiments ran in throwaway detached worktrees under the session scratchpad, since removed.
